title: Amazing Acidic Slovakian Minced Beef Dumplings
description: A kid-friendly Slovakian dish featuring minced beef and a sour taste, made without onions or garlic, and cooked on a salt block. This recipe is perfect for a fun and unique dinner experience.
instructions: Preheat the salt block to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the minced beef, flour, eggs, sour cream, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the dumplings on the preheated salt block, leaving about 1 inch of space between each dumpling.
Cook the dumplings for 5 minutes on the first side, then flip them over and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
While the dumplings are cooking, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Once the dumplings are cooked, brush them with the melted butter and serve hot.
Serve the dumplings with your favorite sides, such as mashed potatoes or steamed vegetables.
